data.one_liner: Securely load and decrypt .env files in Flutter/Dart using AES encryption.
data.what_it_does: It generates Dart classes from encrypted .env files, providing typed access to environment variables. The package handles key/IV management and decryption at runtime.
use_when: You need to keep secrets out of plain text in your repo
You want compile‑time type safety for env variables
You are building a Flutter or Dart app that requires secure config
avoid_when: You need secrets that must never be in the binary (use server‑side key fetch)
You prefer a simple, non‑encrypted dotenv solution
strengths: Strong encryption with AES‑CBC and key/IV handling
Full code‑gen support for typed env classes
weaknesses: Key must be stored in binary unless fetched from server
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, dev_dependencies (build_runner, flutter_secure_dotenv_generator), run build_runner with --define to generate key file, copy key to git‑ignored env.dart, delete key file, then use generated Env class.
